name: Madrid
notes: Madrid: the city series is Idealista's asking price per m² for the whole municipality, monthly from 2007-01, as republished by the city's statistics bank (series 4.3.15.B to 2022, 4.3.15.C from 2023; identical on their overlap). 21 districts (from 2008) and 125 barrios (from 2023) carry the same measure. Asking prices are offer prices of the stock listed for sale, not transaction prices, and not quality-adjusted. Under each area, 'registered sale price (annual)' is the average price per m² declared in the sales registered by the land registries (Colegio de Registradores), 2007-2025, barrio values only with 15+ sales; annual points are joined by interpolation. 14 published monthly points that were evident keying errors (a short run more than 20% off both neighbouring months, which agree with each other) were dropped. The long-history chart is Idealista's earlier quarterly method (2000-2018), not chained to the monthly series.
